༄༅/ /gcod kyi bogs 'don yon tan sgo 'byed bzhugs so/ /

tei:div.tei:p: ༄༅/ /gcod kyi bogs 'don yon tan sgo 'byed bzhugs so/ /

rang dur khrod du 'gro ba'i dus su/ gnyan sa gang yin par phyin la/ byams dang snying rjai tshad med pa zhig bsgoms/ de yi rjes shes pa lhod de glod la/ skad cig dran rdzogs kyi ngang la/ rang rdo rje phag mo ru sgom pa ni/ rdo rje phag mo sku mdog sngon mo zhal gcig phyag gnyis ma/ bcuu drug lon pa'i na tshod can/ spyan gsum khro gnyer gad mo sgrog pa'i tshul ma/ phyag g.yas pa na ḍā ma ru sgrog phyag g.yon pa dril bu gsil ba/ rus pa'i rgyan drug sku la gsol zhing*/ zhabs g.yas pa'i rting pa gsang ba'i bha gar gtad la/ g.yon pa mi ro'i steng na gar stabs mdzad pa/ gar stabs shig ge yod par bsgoms la/ gzan skyur dka' ba spyad pa ni/ rang gi lus 'di gces 'dzin gyis blos ma thongs bas/ sngar yang 'khor bar 'khyams/ da dung yang 'khor ba'i rgyu rkyen byed/ de sbyin par gtong dgos bsams nas/ rang rdo rje phag mo'i mdun du/ lus ri rab dang mnyam par bsgoms la/ da ni lus la chags zhen spu tsam yang med do/ khyod snang srid kyi lha 'dre rnams la sbyin par btang ngo byas la/ /rdo rje phag mo'i phyag gi gri gug gis lus de legs par gtubs nas/ sha yi phung po ri rab tsam/ khrag ni rgya mtsho tsam du dmigs la/ mgron rnams dmigs pa ni/ rtsa brgyud kyi bla ma dang*/ yi dam gyi lha/ mkha' 'gro chos skyong rnams nam mkha' dang bar snang gang bar bsam/ snang srid kyi lha 'dre dang*/ yi dwags 'byung po rnams sa gzhi bar snang gang bar bsams la/ rang rdo rje rnal 'byor mas phyag gi thod pas bcus la/ yar la mchod pas bla ma dang yi dam mnyes par byas/ bar du mchod pas mkha' 'gro ma tshogs kyi thugs dam bskang*/ mar mchod pas snang srid lha 'dre thams cad mgu zhing tshims/ bgegs dang 'byung po yi dwags rnams kyang ngom zhing dga' nas yod par bsams/ de'i ngang rtog pa dang khu 'phrig gnyis 'dzin byung na/ bdag gi lus 'di gnyis 'dzin byas pas 'khor bar 'khyams/

da dung gces 'dzin byas na 'khor bar 'khyams pas/ da ni lus la chags pa med pas/ khyod lha 'dre rnams la sbyin pa btang ngo*/ sha 'dod pa rnams ni sha khyer cig /khrag 'dod pa rnams kyis khrag 'thung*/ nang rol 'dod pa rnams nang rol zos shig /ci yang ma bzhag cig / ring ba rnams ni rlon par zos shig /mi ring ba rnams ni tshos las zos shig / thegs tshad khur cig /sbyin ma nus na nga zhan/ khyer ma nus na khyod zhan/ lus sha khrag gi phung po 'di/ mi gtsang ba'i phung po/ rnam rtog gi tshang*/ rul ba'i rang bzhin/ rnag khrag gi rkyal pa 'di/ nga yir 'dzin pas/ sngar yang don med la song*/ da ni don can du grub la/ phang ni mi phangs/ gces 'dzin mi byed/ bdag tu mi 'dzin/ lus sngar yang sdug bsngal la bskyur bas/ da ni dgos pa med do/ /su 'dod pas khyer cig byas la nyal nas sdod do/ /'jigs pa'i rnam rtog byung na/ lus ni sbyin par btang tshar/ sems ni ngo bo stong pa la shi rgyu med/ 'dre nga rang gi sems su 'dug /'jigs mkhan yang sems su 'dug / sems khyod kyi ngo bo ci 'dra 'dug bltas pas/ dngos po dang kha dog gzugs brnyan gang yang med/ ngo bo stong pa la 'jigs rgyu mi 'dug /'jigs mkhan de rnam rtog tu 'dug /rnam rtog khyod gang nas byung*/ ngo bo gang yin/ mkhan po gang gis byas/ dbyibs dang kha dog ci 'dra 'dug bltas pas/ gang yang dpyad du med/ rnam rtog rjes med du bun ne song ba dang*/ 'jigs mkhan gyi gzhi stor te steng nas thog lhung rung*/ 'og nas mtsho rdol rung*/ lha 'dre'i cho 'phrul ci byung rung*/ de ka'i ngang la 'dzin med du grol thongs/ thogs bcas kyi bdud dang thogs med kyi bdud gang byung yang*/ 'dzin med kyi ngang la zhog cig / dga' brod kyi bdud dang*/ snyems byed kyi bdud dag 'dzin med rang sar bzhag go /de ltar byas pas/ sems gzung 'dzin gyi dri ma zad nas/ sangs rgyas kyi 'bras bu thob bo//
//dge'o// //maṅgalaṃ// mes po'i shul bzhag las/ klong chen rab 'byams kyi gsung 'bum/ (26)gcod kyi bogs 'don yon tan sgo 'byed/ - PAGE 56 -- PAGE 55 -- PAGE 54 -
